tagline: Transform Zoom meetings into searchable Notion documentation
metaTitle: Notion Zoom Integration: Automatic Meeting Notes Pages
metaDescription: Create a Notion notes page for every Zoom call and turn action items into tasks. GAIA skips meetings you mark private. See the setup steps.
intro: Zoom calls generate valuable information — decisions, action items, insights, and commitments — that typically lives in someone's personal notes or disappears entirely. GAIA captures that meeting intelligence and organizes it in Notion automatically, turning every call into a permanent, searchable knowledge asset.

useCases.title: Automatic meeting notes pages
useCases.description: After each Zoom call, GAIA creates a page with meeting date, attendees, duration, and structured sections for key discussion points, decisions made, and action items.

useCases.title: Action item extraction and task creation
useCases.description: GAIA identifies commitments and action items from meeting context and creates tasks in Notion (or your connected task manager) with assigned owners and due dates.

useCases.title: Meeting series documentation
useCases.description: For recurring meetings like weekly standups or monthly reviews, GAIA maintains a running page that appends each meeting's notes, creating a longitudinal record.

useCases.title: Client call summaries
useCases.description: After client calls, GAIA generates a professional summary that can be shared with the client or kept internally as a CRM-style call log.

useCases.title: Team knowledge base from calls
useCases.description: Insights, decisions, and tribal knowledge shared in calls get captured in the relevant sections of the knowledge base, preserving institutional knowledge that would otherwise be lost.

howItWorks.step: Connect Zoom and Notion to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Zoom account and Notion workspace. GAIA will monitor your meeting activity and create pages after each call.
Choose your preferred meeting notes template and which section receives notes from different types of calls (team, client, one-on-one, etc.).

howItWorks.step: Review and refine automatically generated notes
howItWorks.description: GAIA creates a draft notes page after each call. You review, add any context, and the note becomes part of your permanent knowledge base.

faqs.question: Does GAIA require Zoom's cloud recording feature?
faqs.answer: GAIA can work with calendar context and meeting metadata without recording. However, for richer notes including action item extraction, cloud recording with auto-transcription significantly improves accuracy.

faqs.question: How does GAIA handle sensitive meetings that shouldn't be documented?
faqs.answer: You can configure GAIA to exclude specific meeting types, meeting names containing certain keywords, or calendar events tagged as confidential from automatic documentation.

faqs.question: Can notes be shared with meeting attendees automatically?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can be configured to share the notes page link with all attendees via email or Slack after the notes are created, keeping everyone aligned.
